يرتضخون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَضِخُونَ (yartaḍiḵūna) /jar.ta.dˤi.xuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# يُرْتَضَخُونَ (yurtaḍaḵūna) /jur.ta.dˤa.xuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
